name: KITE Robotics facade cleaning robot
summary: A facade cleaning robot that hangs from four anchor points at the roof corners and cleans glass and panel facades 15 to 200 m high at 300 to 800 m² per hour, with nobody on the facade.

germany.statusNote: The Dutch maker sells or leases the robot per building and takes quote requests on its German website; no public price. Reference buildings are in the Netherlands and London; no German project, office or partner was found.

sellers.name: Kite Robotics International B.V.
sellers.note: Oldenzaal, Netherlands. Quote ("Angebot anfordern") needs the building data; robot can be bought or leased (FAQ).

specs.label: Cleaning rate
specs.conditions: depending on facade structure and reveal depth

specs.label: Building height
specs.conditions: from 15 m to 200 m and higher; FAQ gives 200 m as standard maximum

specs.label: Facade width
specs.value: No limit; large facades are split into sections

specs.label: Anchoring
specs.value: 4 anchor points at the corners of the facade

specs.label: Window reveal depth
specs.conditions: standard; custom systems up to 45 cm

specs.label: Facade types
specs.value: Vertical, positively sloped and round facades; aluminium, stone, natural stone and composite; atrium roofs as special systems

specs.label: Cleaning water
specs.value: Reverse-osmosis (demineralised) water, streak-free drying without chemicals

specs.label: Control
specs.value: Manual by joystick or automatic (autonomous cleaning)

notes: Installed per building: needs four anchor points at the facade corners; the system is configured to the building, so it is not a robot you move from site to site.
Building owner or cleaning contractor can buy or lease it; remote diagnostics and maintenance contracts are offered.
Replaces a building maintenance unit (BMU) for cleaning; KITE also offers a facade inspection system (KFIS), not covered here.
Weight, power supply and wind limits are not published.
